name: Core WECA inter-urban active travel network

metadata.methodology_notes: SATN-style Stage 1 network: prioritised inter-urban links between bounded urban areas and strategic external gateways. Geometry follows named A-road corridors with coarse intermediate control points where possible, but remains corridor/desire-line evidence rather than design alignment.

properties.corridor_name: A4 Bristol to Bath and Batheaston
properties.urban_complexity_handling: Treat bounded urban areas as LCWIP/interface zones; do not solve detailed urban alignments in this layer.
properties.quiet_route_policy: Quiet routes may provide reach or parallel options but do not replace the direct inter-urban A-road corridor unless the route audit shows the A-road is not viable.
properties.personal_safety_policy: Direct, legible, overlooked corridors are preferred where a suitable A-road-adjacent facility can be delivered.
properties.provenance_notes: Prototype link selected from WECA urban areas, major neighbouring gateways and named A-road corridors.
properties.uncertainty_notes: Requires route audit, highway boundary review, traffic-speed context and land/constraint checks before any design conclusion.
